events.title: Story Trailer, Pricing, And Discounts!
events.summary: Whether you're new to Fabletown or you've been here before, we're trying to do right by you at launch. Here's the breakdown of pricing and launch discounts (off the $24.99 price) for The Wolf Among Us Remastered. Plus, get a peek at Bigby's Big Bad Wolf makeover in the new story trailer!

events.title: Next Fest Demo!
events.summary: RIGHT NOW, you can download the free demo for The Wolf Among Us Remastered during Steam Next Fest! (We could not wait for October 29th!) Grab it, play it, and let us know what you think!

events.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered: Next Fest Playthrough
events.summary: Watch the Telltale team play the Steam Next Fest demo of The Wolf Among Us Remastered.The developers who brought Fabletown back sit down to play Episode 1, the same demo you can download right now, and talk through the remaster as they go.Play it yourself. The demo is free for the length of Steam Next Fest, through October 26.Wishlist now. The Wolf Among Us Remastered launches October 29, 2026.

Every interrogation, back alley, and hard choice plays out like the detective film Fabletown always deserved. With one tap, jump between Noir Mode and the fully remastered look whenever you want.
